batch_name: SHS Direct Connect Batch 2 Data Model

models.ConnectorSource: Defines a local/mock connector source, source category, support posture, data sensitivity, allowed destinations, and deferred live features.
models.ConnectorConnection: Tracks one client or project connection posture without credentials, live auth, OAuth, or external sync.
models.ConnectorFieldMapping: Maps source fields to SHS target fields and marks mapping readiness.
models.ConnectorSyncRun: Records mock import, mapping, approval, blocked, and deferred sync evidence.
models.ConnectorAuditEvent: Captures connector, mapping, approval, report binding, financial block, SHF boundary, and banking deferral events.
models.ConnectorApprovalStatus: Records allowed and denied uses, public impact eligibility, and financial public-impact blocking.
models.ReportSourceBinding: Binds a connector connection to report trust-panel or internal-only source usage.

trust_rules: External data is not trusted by default.
Connected data is private by default.
Public SHF use requires SHF Data Approval Gateway approval.
Financial data must never become public impact data by default.
Mock connections must be labeled clearly.
Every sync/import must create an audit event.
Every report binding must show source and approval status.
Direct Connect does not bypass SHF approval.
report_clientops_readiness: ReportSourceBinding records identify trust-panel visibility, approval status, last verification, and intended report use.
ConnectorConnection records expose report eligibility, public impact eligibility, approval status, and client ownership.
SHS Internal Ops and Client OS style records prepare future ClientOps readiness and monthly review usage.
Financial sources can support internal summaries only when approved and remain blocked from public impact by default.
shf_boundary_protections: Direct Connect does not approve public SHF impact use by itself.
Public SHF use requires SHF Data Approval Gateway approval.
Financial data must never become public impact data by default.
The SHF Approval Gateway mock source represents an approval boundary rather than a bypass.
Banking, payment, and accounting records are blocked from public impact eligibility by default.
